results.title: AI becomes a core professional skill as employees welcome employer-led upskilling, new eDreams ODIGEO research finds
results.description: - - • Survey of 9,000 people across seven markets finds strong demand for employer-led training, with appetite strongest in Portugal (79%), Spain (73%) and Italy (72%), followed by Germany (68%), the United States (61%), France (55%) and the UK (54%). - • AI-first credentials increasingly influence job choices, with 57% of respondents in Portugal, 54% in Spain and 48% in Germany saying a company's AI-first reputation would matter when choosing between two similar job offers. - • One exa...
